qualification.providerInference: Synthetic model gateways and local controlled peers only; no paid provider inference

scope: Backend-private durable event observation checkpoint foundation
storage: PersistenceService information compare-and-set through embedded xlang3 SQLite; no direct SQLite
semantics: open binds a consumer to its original zero/empty cursor
stage stores a bounded validated page without moving accepted cursor
identical restaging is idempotent; different competing page conflicts
accept requires exact staged revision and cursor; duplicate acknowledgement is idempotent
empty resume does not advance revision
epoch replacement requires explicit authoritative reset; no implicit reset
verified: retained pending page and original accepted cursor after reopen
limitations: not live authorization; service must freshly validate captured scope before returning a retained page or accepting acknowledgement
not yet integrated into RemoteConnectionAuthentication or public SDK/CLI/HTTP consumer methods
no authoritative snapshot/reset or root-tree checkpoint workflow
no new full-suite or installation qualification
